svg.title: Location cycle simulation traces
svg.desc: Six locations m0 through m5 repeat in order. Separate panels preserve visibility of x0, x1 and x2 at their different scales. The clock resets to zero at each rising dwell crossing while the other coordinates remain continuous; colored bands identify active locations.
